steps.text: A flame needs oxygen to keep burning. Let's prove it with a candle and a jar.
Tap “Light Candle” to start the flame.
Now tap “Cover with Jar” to trap the candle under glass.
The flame uses up the oxygen inside and goes out. No oxygen means no combustion — the same reason a jar smothers a fire.

coach.mission: Light the candle, then cover it and watch what happens.
whenStuck: Watch how long the flame lasts once it's covered.
whenWrong: The flame goes out because the trapped air runs out of oxygen.
No oxygen, no fire — that's why covering it works.
whenCorrect: Right — the flame died once the oxygen ran out.
Good — cutting off oxygen stops combustion.
coach.done: You've shown a flame needs oxygen to burn. Reset and try again, or move on when you're ready.
